name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Partner Marketing & Integrated Campaign Manager
summary: Marketing manager with 15+ years running integrated B2B campaigns end to end, from audience segmentation and go-to-market planning through delivery and reporting. Built and managed a channel/reseller partner network at Birdeye (15-20 partners, ~94% retention) and now architects full-funnel marketing automation at Solenzo across GoHighLevel and HubSpot, with hands-on Salesforce experience from two prior SaaS roles. Comfortable running experimentation (A/B testing, CRO) and always-on lifecycle campaigns inside a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.

Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system — 20+ workflows — spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, lead qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and long-term reactivation.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot — contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead-routing logic, with strict data-hygiene protocols.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

Optimized a client's Google Ads account — cut spam/low-quality leads and improved click-through quality — and diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck, demonstrating full-funnel troubleshooting.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments.
Designed and ran LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based-marketing approach, targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups rather than broad targeting.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced high-converting campaign assets — landing pages, complex email sequences, conversion-focused copy — improving lead generation and pipeline.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
